narr: Multiple rounds of strong to severe storms affected the area with impacts to trees and power lines. In addition, persistent heavy rain along the coast resulted in flooding in portions of Gulf county with over a foot of rain reported.
ev: Portions of Oak Grove Ave were underwater.

A driveway was completely submerged in flood waters. A storm total rainfall of 13.65 inches was measured less than a mile away. Most of that rain fell in a 24-36 hour period with several inches falling in just a few hours.
